decision_contract.rule: Preserve FC-7E baseline identity. Measurement serves the route; the route is not distorted to serve measurement.
A single observation may confirm a mechanic/value for that event, but does not prove global optimum or causality.
A within-run low-level vs later-level pair may support a level-effect candidate only if drill, drill level and Cheer setting are comparable; full route-order causality is deferred to FC-7G.
Match value is state-dependent. Never convert observed samples into a fixed matches-per-month rule in FC-7F.
Roster decisions classify players as CORE_DEVELOP, BRIDGE_START, FUNCTIONAL, or REPLACE_CANDIDATE; low growth alone never forces benching.

Batter training follows observed failure mode: insufficient contact/strikeout problem -> batting; contact without run conversion -> middle-order slugging/skill candidate; adequate scoring -> stop marginal training and return to matches.

Pitcher training follows observed failure mode: walk/control collapse -> control; low K/contact problem -> breaking; broad power gap after control/breaking are adequate -> velocity candidate; if pitching keeps C-grade games winnable while offense binds, stop pitching investment.
Sports is not spent on school activities solely to generate calibration data. Point ROI is measured from strategically justified actions.
Items are measured only when strategically justified. Recovery ROI is primarily whether an otherwise blocked high-value action becomes available; broad equipment spending remains unresolved.
Facility count is never pre-fixed. Add capacity only when an observed recovery/movement/resource bottleneck blocks high-value activity; record before/after throughput.
Two equivalent failed attempts to extract a usable calibration signal trigger method change, not repeated brute-force measurement.
Current historical run may supply mechanic/control examples but may not be used as the fastest-route chronology or resource-allocation authority.
FC-7F outputs are calibration candidates. Global route selection and start/branch comparison remain FC-7G; combat thresholds remain FC-7H.

required: at least one low-level training measurement captured
roster decisions are logged with growth/fit/personality/current-ability context
batter and pitcher failure modes can be classified from live evidence
resource/item/facility modules contain observed rows if and only if those actions were strategically justified
not_required: all eight modules having equal sample counts
an item purchase solely for measurement
a second/third shower solely for measurement
